description: This file is a JavaScript module that provides functions for generating PowerPoint presentations programmatically using the pptxgenjs library. It includes utility functions for handling data URLs, applying transformations, resolving template placeholders, rendering shapes and images, and ultimately creating a PPTX file based on a template model, extracted template data, user inputs, and slide ordering. The main exported function 'generatePptx' orchestrates the process of slide creation, including background setup, adding text and images, handling global slides, and fallback rendering.

methods.name: isProbablyDataUrl(v)
methods.description: Checks if a string appears to be a data URL based on the 'data:' prefix.

methods.name: fileToDataUrl(file)
methods.description: Converts a File object or data URL string into a data URL string asynchronously.

methods.name: urlToDataUrl(url)
methods.description: Fetches a URL and converts the response blob into a data URL string asynchronously.

methods.name: applyTransform(value, transformName)
methods.description: Applies specified transformations (e.g., percentage, currency, bullets to lines) to a given value.

methods.name: resolveDeckTitle(wizardData)
methods.description: Determines the title of the presentation based on the globalFirst name or defaults.

methods.name: formatGlobalFirstLabeledLine(fieldId, rawValue)
methods.description: Formats label lines for 'Name' and 'Date' in the Global First slide, showing placeholders if data is missing.

methods.name: safeFileName(name)
methods.description: Generates a safe filename string from a given name, sanitizing characters and length.

methods.name: resolveValueForStep(wizardData, slideStep, fieldId)
methods.description: Resolves a data value for a specific slide step and field based on the scope and data path.

methods.name: ptToIn(pt)
methods.description: Converts value from points to inches for layout positioning.

methods.name: addFallbackText(slide, i, value)
methods.description: Adds placeholder fallback text to a slide if actual data is missing.

methods.name: addFallbackImage(slide, i, fileOrUrl)
methods.description: Adds placeholder fallback image to a slide if actual image data is missing.

methods.name: renderFixedShapes(slide, layout, templateIndex)
methods.description: Renders predefined fixed shapes (like rectangles or pictures) onto a slide based on layout configuration.

methods.name: generatePptx({ templateModel, extractedTemplate, orderedSlides, wizardData })
methods.description: Main exported function to generate a PowerPoint presentation blob and filename from templates, slides, and data.

ctags.name: generatePptx
ctags.pattern: /^export async function generatePptx({ templateModel, extractedTemplate, orderedSlides, wizardData/
